resolution: fixed (27.5) — the arrow detector now claims the bare Arrow IPC *stream* framing (a continuation-marked `Schema` message first, then well-formed `RecordBatch`/`DictionaryBatch` messages, ending in an end-of-stream marker) in addition to the file format (magic+footer) and the historical magic+padding-prefixed stream; all four `arrow-stream-*.stream` samples are now claimed as `arrow`. The legacy pre-0.15 no-continuation framing is deliberately declined (a magic-less source has no other anchor, and the stream parser admits only the continuation form). Regression tests `arrow_adapter::stream_framing_is_detected_and_messages_are_ordered_and_exact`, `arrow_adapter::stream_near_misses_decline_to_opaque`, and court `tools/phase27-5-1-arrow-stream-court.sh` (src/adapter/arrow.rs).

recorded misclassification (precedence) — the reST detector is tried before AsciiDoc and claims attribute-only/locale/CHANGELOG AsciiDoc via its field-list (`:name: value`) / adornment signal; AsciiDoc attribute entries are syntactically RST field lists, and reordering AsciiDoc before reST is not clearly warranted (reST precedence is load-bearing), so it is not reordered (src/adapter/rst.rs, asciidoc.rs).

recorded decline — a `* xref:` link-list-only AsciiDoc page carries no AsciiDoc-specific block/title signal (no `=` title, `==` section, `|===` table, delimited block, or `[…]` block-attribute line), so it stays Opaque rather than being guessed (src/adapter/asciidoc.rs).

recorded decline — a lone integer, a tagged date, and an RFC 8949 multi-value concatenation all fall below the detector's deliberate bar (a full-input single well-formed parse whose root is a container/tag reaching >= 3 nodes); conservative by design (src/adapter/cbor.rs).

recorded decline — two distinct causes: (a) `Bug60942b.doc` is a **Word 6.0** FIB (`wIdent` 0xA5DC, `nFib` 0x0065), which is outside the supported Word 97-2003 `nFib` subset the adapter models, so it stays at the generic CFBF layer; (b) `testRangeDelete.doc` has a genuine Word FIB but its `WordDocument` mini-stream is **fragmented and its root mini stream is itself fragmented**, so the first chunk's absolute offset is not recoverable from the model and `stream_leading` conservatively declines (src/adapter/doc.rs, cfbf.rs).

recorded decline — the sample is an **mbox** (a leading `From ` envelope line, not an RFC 5322 header) whose `multipart/report` boundary is folded and truncated (`;\\n\\tbo`), so the bounded header-block scan declines rather than admitting an unmodellable message container (src/adapter/eml.rs).

fixed — GPX 1.0 (`http://www.topografix.com/GPX/1/0`, same `gpx` dialect) and a **namespace-less** `<kml>` with a recognized structural child are now claimed (src/adapter/gis.rs, `declares_ns` + `GPX_1_0_NS`); regression tests `gis::tests::detects_kml_and_gpx_and_rejects_junk` and `gis_adapter::detection_is_byte_based_and_conservative`.
